entry_code_session_requires_opening.name: entry_code_session_requires_opening
entry_code_session_requires_opening.value: "entry_code"."group_session_id" is null or "entry_code"."opening_id" is not null

application_closed_has_reason.name: application_closed_has_reason
application_closed_has_reason.value: "application"."closed_outcome" is null or "application"."closed_reason_option_id" is not null

application_event_closed_has_outcome_and.name: application_event_closed_has_outcome_and_reason
application_event_closed_has_outcome_and.value: "application_event"."kind" <> 'closed' or ("application_event"."closed_outcome" is not null and "application_event"."reason_option_id" is not null)

person_one_per_unshared_mobile.name: person_one_per_unshared_mobile
person_one_per_unshared_mobile.where: mobile_e164 is not null and not shared_mobile

person_name_required_unless_redacted.name: person_name_required_unless_redacted
person_name_required_unless_redacted.value: "person"."redacted_at" is not null or ("person"."first_name" is not null and "person"."last_name" is not null)

message_addresses_unless_redacted.name: message_addresses_unless_redacted
message_addresses_unless_redacted.value: "message"."redacted_at" is not null or ("message"."to_address" is not null and "message"."from_address" is not null)

background_check_final_adverse_needs_pre.name: background_check_final_adverse_needs_pre_adverse
background_check_final_adverse_needs_pre.value: "background_check"."final_adverse_on" is null or "background_check"."pre_adverse_notice_on" is not null

hire_stint_one_active_per_person_per_ope.name: hire_stint_one_active_per_person_per_opening
hire_stint_one_active_per_person_per_ope.where: voided_at is null and outcome = 'active' and opening_id is not null

hire_stint_separation_fields.name: hire_stint_separation_fields
hire_stint_separation_fields.value: "hire_stint"."outcome" not in ('separated', 'never_started') or ("hire_stint"."separation_type" is not null and "hire_stint"."leave_reason_option_id" is not null and "hire_stint"."end_on" is not null)

hire_stint_end_after_start.name: hire_stint_end_after_start
hire_stint_end_after_start.value: "hire_stint"."start_on" is null or "hire_stint"."end_on" is null or "hire_stint"."end_on" >= "hire_stint"."start_on"

hire_stint_last_worked_in_range.name: hire_stint_last_worked_in_range
hire_stint_last_worked_in_range.value: "hire_stint"."last_worked_on" is null or (("hire_stint"."start_on" is null or "hire_stint"."last_worked_on" >= "hire_stint"."start_on") and ("hire_stint"."end_on" is null or "hire_stint"."last_worked_on" <= "hire_stint"."end_on"))

hire_stint_ats_has_application.name: hire_stint_ats_has_application
hire_stint_ats_has_application.value: "hire_stint"."origin" <> 'ats' or ("hire_stint"."application_id" is not null and "hire_stint"."opening_id" is not null)
